phase_10_fp_gates.action: Run 5 schema quality checks (adapted FP gates)
checks: Type completeness: All JSON fields from code represented in schemas
Type correctness: Types match JSON (number vs string vs bool vs array vs object)
No loose types: No {...} or [...] without type constraints
Consistent naming: Field names match JSON output exactly
Documentation: All schemas have descriptive comments
phase_10_fp_gates.method: Manual review of each schema against intent.gleam code

phase_14_liability.action: Ensure schemas are minimal and well-documented
checks: No unnecessary complexity in type definitions
Clear comments explain purpose of each schema
No over-constrained types that might break on valid inputs
Optional fields marked with ? where appropriate
Union types used for conditional outputs (e.g., lint)
